html: † סַבְתָּה, סַבְתָּא n.pr.gent. 3rd ‘son’ of Cush according to Gn 10:7 (ה—ָ), = 1 Ch 1:9 (א—ָ); identif. with Σαββαθα [Periplus maris Erythr.27], Σαυβαθα Ptol vi. 7, 38, or Σαβατα [Straboxvi. 42], Sabota [PlinNH vi. § 155, xii. 63], old commercial city of S. Arabia, by Tuch Ku, but this = Sab. שבות (not ס׳) Levy-OsZMG xix (1865), 253; xx (1866), 273, cf. HalJAs 7, iv. 525; GlaserSkizze ii. 252 f. proposes Σαφθα (Ptol vi. 7, 30), near W. shore of Pers. Gulf; 𝔊 Σαβαθα, Σαβατα, Σεβαθα. All uncertain conjectures.
